skills.name: grasp-a-cup
skills.procedure: Pick one cup: measure the color window live, locate by depth evidence, touch the top, grasp at the pad band with two closes, check the lift.

skills.name: stack-two-cups
skills.procedure: Stack one cup on another: locate both, grasp, find the release height by force, verify from a profile view.

skills.name: grasp-a-cylinder
skills.procedure: Pick a cylinder: read its orientation from the silhouette, center it with or without depth, check the stall width.

skills.name: insert-into-a-hole
skills.procedure: Insert into the round hole: identify the hole, measure it parallax-free, find the face by touch, use a force-free descent as the alignment test, verify by look.

skills.name: grasp-a-ring
skills.procedure: Pick a flat ring at the jaw's span limit: locate by color, straddle with a force-watched open-jaw descent, check the stall width.

skills.name: put-a-ring-on-a-rod
skills.procedure: Thread the held ring onto the rod: find the tip by its marker, predict the ground-out height, verify by a force-free descent and a top-down look.
